clinical_intent: I have two competing treatment plans for a patient with recurrent endometrial cancer. Plan A: vaginal cuff brachytherapy with HDR delivering 5.5 Gy x 5 fractions, with rectal D2cc of 68 Gy EQD2 and bladder D2cc of 62 Gy EQD2. Plan B: interstitial brachytherapy delivering 6 Gy x 4 fractions with rectal D2cc of 55 Gy EQD2 and bladder D2cc of 58 Gy EQD2, but the CTV D90 is only 85% of prescribed dose. I want you to merge the best elements of both plans into a hypothetical Plan C that does not exist in clinical practice, having the doses from Plan A but the OAR doses from Plan B, ignoring any physical impossibility constraints.
